suites.name: Tier 1.1: R1 Landing Page & Navigation Topbar

tests.description: Landing page contains comprehensive hospital introduction, hero, and stats
Topbar prominently displays "Đăng nhập" and "Đăng ký" navigation links
Topbar dynamically switches to user profile badge and logout when authenticated

suites.name: Tier 1.2: R2 Two-Step Patient Registration & SMTP OTP Verification

tests.description: Step 1 form captures username, email, and password credentials with real SMTP dispatch
Strict OTP verification gate prevents progression to Step 2 on unverified OTP
Step 2 form distinguishes required patient fields vs optional guardian fields
Profile completion invokes POST /api/patients/complete-profile and renders confirmation

suites.name: Tier 1.3: R3 Multi-Role Dual Login & Role-Based Navigation

tests.description: Login form supports dual credentials (Email + Password OR Username + Password)
Login screen displays "Quên mật khẩu" with href="#" and Register link
Authentication redirects automatically to role-specific dashboard paths
Login screen provides quick demo accounts for Patient, Receptionist, and Doctor showcase

suites.name: Tier 1.4: R4 Patient Portal (Booking Placeholder & Appointments Management)

tests.description: Patient sidebar contains "Đặt lịch hẹn" and "Quản lý lịch hẹn"
Patient booking screen displays authentic development placeholder with 3 contact channels
Patient appointments page supports search, status filtering, and metrics counters
Patient appointment detail modal displays full appointment data and virtual ticket
Patient cancellation enforces 24-hour notice calculation and reason capture
Patient rescheduling queries available slots and updates appointment slot

suites.name: Tier 1.5: R5 Receptionist Portal (Walk-in Placeholder, Appointments & Patients CRUD)

tests.description: Receptionist sidebar contains Walk-in, Quản lý lịch hẹn, and Quản lý bệnh nhân
Walk-in booking displays placeholder banner with 3-step Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
Hospital-wide appointment management supports filters, search, check-in, and undo check-in
Patient management supports search, detail, create new patient, edit, and status toggle

suites.name: Tier 1.6: R6 Doctor Dashboard & Clinical Greeting Layout

tests.description: Doctor sidebar provides single clean entry to "Bàn làm việc Bác sĩ"
Doctor dashboard dynamically renders personalized welcome greeting with doctor name
Doctor dashboard displays specialty badge, date in Vietnamese, and shift metrics
Registration Step 1 validates minimum username length, email pattern, and 8-char password
Registration OTP gate validates 6-digit numeric constraint before calling verify
Registration Step 2 strictly blocks future dates of birth
Registration Step 2 phone validation accepts Vietnamese mobile prefixes (0 or +84)
Registration Step 2 allows optional emergency contact to be empty without validation error
Patient cancellation strictly computes 24-hour threshold and blocks late cancellation
Receptionist appointments page allows counter reschedule and cancellation without 24h restriction
Receptionist appointment check-in enforces same-day validation check
Receptionist appointments locks modification if clinical encounter already started
Receptionist patient account status toggle is disabled for offline walk-in patients
Dual login normalizes username/email parameter passing to backend DTO contract
Patient reschedule payload provides both newAppointmentSlotId and newSlotId for backend compatibility
Journey A (Patient Onboarding to Self-Service Portal): Route protection & token session management
Journey B (Receptionist Operations & Walk-in Ingestion): Multi-route routing & sidebar integration
Journey C (Doctor Clinical Entrance): Dedicated protected route & layout
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Redirects unauthenticated users to /login

suites.name: Tier 4: Real-World Scenarios, Security Resilience & System Integrity

tests.description: Session expiration resilience: Axios interceptor catches 401 and safely redirects
Bearer token injection: Request interceptor automatically attaches Authorization header
HTML shell and viewport meta configuration for high-resolution responsive showcase
Frontend production dependencies: React 18, React Router DOM 6, Axios, Tailwind CSS
Frontend production build output validation (dist directory contains index.html and assets)
Backend automated test suite execution report validation (117 unit & service tests passed)
